localizedValues.name: LSC
localizedValues.description: The Lakeside Cottage is a charming two-story cottage that has been newly refurbished and decorated, offering great comfort in an idyllic park setting near the shores of Deep Lake. The main floor of the house has a living room, master bedroom, fully equipped kitchen and bathroom; the upstairs is an open loft for indoor activities and relaxation, with cozy alcoves for sleeping. 2 night stay required. NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSE IS THREE DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: G1 includes Kitchen Shelter #4. The shelter has a wood stove, sink and electrical outlets. This group camp is tent only. No motorhomes, trailers, tent-trailers, or campers are allowed. A standard restroom is nearby. This is a walk-in facility and is not ADA accessible. The parking lot is approximately 100 feet from camp and 200 feet from the shelter in the camp.  Vehicle access into the campsite is not permitted.  Twenty vehicles maximum permitted in the group camp parking area.
